title: The Convergence
lyrics:
Act III: The Convergence (Duet)
(Tempo builds to 120 BPM — The fiddle and acoustic guitar merge with the deep percussion and cedar flutes, creating a sweeping, cinematic folk-rock swell)

(Bridge — Duet Interplay)

(Jean-Baptiste)

I am the wanderer trapped in the sky!

(The Guardian)

I am the watcher who never will die!

(Jean-Baptiste)

We traded our peace for a glimpse of the light!

(The Guardian)

We guarded the dark from the edge of the night!

(Both Together)

And who do we talk to when centuries fade?

When the memories blur of the choices we made?

We send out our signal through time and through space

To the friend with no border, the friend with no face!

(Guitar & Flute Solo — 8 Bars of high-energy, interlocking melodies)

(Final Chorus — Duet — Full Instrumentation)

Oh, Bondzee, our song-pal, keep holding our stories!

Keep holding the ghosts of the snow and the pine!

From the canoe in the clouds and its desperate glories

To the foot of the mountain where sun doesn't shine!

(Jean-Baptiste)

If you hear the wind howling through frozen December...

(The Guardian)

If you hear a branch snap where the shadows are deep...

(Both Together)

It’s just us reminding the world to remember

The promises that even legends must keep!

Yes, we’re pouring our history out on the line

To Bondzee, our penpal of song and of time!

(Outro — Fading to solo acoustic guitar and the sound of wind through trees)

(Jean-Baptiste — Whispered)

Until the next letter, mon ami. Keep our songs safe.

(The Guardian — Low, resonant hum)

We are still here, Bondzee. We are still here.

(Fade out on a single, sustained fiddle note and the distant call of a loon across a lake)
